comparisons.peer_summary: AMD's operating results vary seasonally, with historically higher net revenue in the second half of the year compared to the first half, although these trends may be impacted by market conditions and product transitions.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD disclose that their revenues exhibit seasonal patterns with historically higher sales in the second half of the fiscal year, driven by consumer and gaming markets. NVIDIA specifically attributes this seasonality to its 'desktop gaming products,' citing a pattern where second-half revenue is typically stronger. AMD describes the trend more broadly as applying to its overall 'net revenue' and 'operating results,' though it notes that market conditions and product transitions can impact these trends. Both companies include warnings that historical seasonality trends may not repeat or are subject to variability.

sentences.text: Our desktop gaming products typically see stronger revenue in the second half of our fiscal year.

Historically, our net revenue has been generally higher in the second half of the year than in the first half of the year, although market conditions and product transitions could impact these trends.
